menu.cancelBody: The steps at work stop. Their sessions stay, so you can read what was done.
menu.cancelBodyBranch: The steps at work stop. Their sessions, the task’s worktree and its branch stay.
menu.deleteBody: The task and its steps’ sessions can’t be restored. Archive keeps them.
menu.deleteBodyBranch: The task and its steps’ sessions can’t be restored. The branch {{branch}} and its worktree stay.

sentBack.left_one: Can be sent back {{count}} more time
sentBack.left_other: Can be sent back {{count}} more times
sentBack.last: The last time it can be sent back

page.hostAway: Its computer isn’t connected. It shows again once it is.
page.missingBody: It was deleted, or its computer no longer lists it.

review.title: {{step}} is waiting for your review
review.comments_one: Your comment on the document goes back to {{agent}} with a send back
review.comments_other: Your {{count}} comments on the document go back to {{agent}} with a send back
review.notePlaceholder: What {{agent}} should change, if you send it back
review.sendBackEmpty: Say what to change, or comment on the document, before sending it back.

asking.title: {{agent}} in {{step}} is asking you
asking.body: Its session waits for a permission or an answer.

blocked.title: {{step}} can’t start
blocked.limitAt: {{agent}} has reached its plan limit. The step starts at {{time}} unless you pin someone else.
blocked.harness: {{agent}} can’t do steps; only Claude Code and Codex can.
blocked.model: {{agent}} no longer lists the model it was pinned with.
blocked.effort: {{agent}} no longer offers the effort it was pinned with.
blocked.no_kettu: {{agent}} doesn’t have Kettu’s tools, which a step reports with.
blocked.tools: It needs {{tools}}, which this computer doesn’t have installed and on. Add it in the Marketplace, then retry.
blocked.noAgent: No agent is allowed for Auto. Turn one on in Settings › Agents, or pin someone.
blocked.noPicker: No step handed off to it, so it needs someone pinned.
blocked.picking: It waits for the step before it to pick who does it.

stuck.send_back_limit: {{step}} was sent back as often as the workflow allows.
stuck.no_report: Its session stopped without reporting, after one reminder.
stuck.no_pick: Its session stopped without picking who does the next step, after one reminder.
stuck.picks_refused: Three picks in a row didn’t hold.
stuck.merge_failed: Merging the branches at the join failed.

merge.title: The task’s branch didn’t merge at the end
merge.body_one: {{count}} file conflicts. Resolve it in the task’s worktree, then retry.
merge.body_other: {{count}} files conflict. Resolve them in the task’s worktree, then retry.

retry.notePlaceholder: A note for the step’s agent (optional)

pin.onlySteps: Only Claude Code and Codex agents can do steps.

composer.label: Add to the task
composer.placeholder: Add to the task for the running step and every step after it
composer.droppedLine: Task ended as not worth doing
